nominal-voltage.description: Reference voltage for the per-unit thresholds (e.g. `120` or `240`).

undervoltage-threshold.description: The voltage at or below which the publisher reduces its import current (e.g. `0.95`).

restore-threshold.description: The voltage at or above which normal operation resumes; MUST be `>= undervoltage-threshold`. The gap is the deadband that prevents chatter (e.g. `0.96`).

reduced-import-limit.description: The import current limit the publisher applies while voltage is below `undervoltage-threshold`. (A publisher MAY instead express this as a fraction of the prevailing limit via `response-curve`.)

mode.description: `OFF` (function present but not acting), `AUTONOMOUS` (the publisher enforces the setpoint locally).

response-curve.description: **Optional richer form.** A piecewise Volt-Watt-style curve, one atomic object (schema below), for a proportional rather than single-threshold response. When present, it supersedes the scalar threshold properties above.
